(rule!
  (fold-cells g g
    (lambda (out r c v)
      (if (= v 0) out (set-cell out c r v)))))

(rule!
  (fold-cells g g
    (lambda (out r c v)
      (if (= v 0) out (set-cell out c r v)))))

(rule!
  (let* ((mirrored (fold-cells g g
    (lambda (out r c v)
      (if (= v 0) out (set-cell out c r v)))))
         (n (rows mirrored)))
    (for*/fold ((out mirrored))
      ((r (in-range n))
       (c (in-range (+ r 1) n)))
      (let ((v (at mirrored r c)))
        (if (and (not (= v 0)) (= (at mirrored c r) v))
            (for/fold ((painted out))
              ((k (in-range (+ (- c r) 1))))
              (set-cell painted (+ r k) (- c k) v))
            out)))))
